title: Ray's Agriculture
description: A port of my Ray's Dongles mod containing all my food items & crops
body:
This is the 3rd and final port for Ray's Dongles. This mod brings all the food, & crops from Ray's Dongles, to its own mod with minor changes!

Lemon & Orange bushes can now be found spawning around the world. There is an overlay saying what bush is what when you look at it. That way when its not fully grown, you can tell which bush it is! They act the same as the Sweet Berry bush from Vanilla, except mine do not hurt you when you walk through them, or slow you.


Lemons & Oranges can be harvested with a right click on a fully grown bush... once you receive a Lemon, or Orange, you can right click it on any grass block to begin growing your very own bush!


Corn & Strawberry seeds can be found from wild crops growing around the world. They are treated the same as Vanilla short grass. They have a chance to drop Corn & Strawberry seeds, but won't always.
 

A new block called the Cutting Board has been added! You can place this in your world, and right click it to get smaller versions of the food you are cutting! A tooltip has been added to the Cutting Board letting you know which food items it accepts

Currently it turns Apples into Apple slices, Carrots into Carrot slices, Cooked Chicken into Chicken nuggets, Melon slices into Melon wedges, Potatoes into Potato wedges, baked Potatoes into baked Potato wedges, & raw Beef into raw Beef slices.


There is also a Blender block that acts the same as the cutting board. If you hover over that in game, it will tell you which food items it accepts as well. This makes various juices and smoothies.


Ray's Materials now available on Curseforge & Modrinth!
